QuestInfo.0: #p2111003# is the one being that cannot be fully categorized as either a robot, or a human. He apparently has something he desires more than anything else. I better go see #p2111003#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2111003# wants to give #t4031695# to #p2111004# as a gift, and he's asked you to bring #b5 #t4000353#s#k and #b5 #t4000359#s#k. You can get #t4000353#s from #r#o3110300#s#k and #t4000359#s from #r#o4110302#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: Once I got him all the materials, #p2111003# gave me a sincere thanks for the work. He seemed so happy... but why does he want to give Phyllia a present? Does he love her...?

0.0: Hello, traveler. Have you...seen #b#t4031695##k by any chance? It's snowy white, kind of transparent rose... with a gorgeous scent. I really want to give that to #p2111004#... Can you help me make my wish come true?

yes.0: Please bring me #b5 #t4000353#s#k and #b5 #t4000359#s#k. You can get #t4000353#s from #r#o3110300#s#k and #t4000359#s from #r#o4110302#s#k. I've already gotten #t4031696#s from another friendly explorer. I do need the rest, however.

no.0: ...If it's too much, then I understand. I guess things like this should be taken care of alone...

1.0: Ah.... You brought them all. Thank you so much... Now I need to make #t4031695#...

yes.0: I believe #p2111004#... will really like #t4031695#. I don't know why, but... I just feel that she'll like it.

item.0: I guess you must've forgotten about my request. Get 5 #t4000353#s from #r#o3110300##k and #b5 #t4000359#s#k from #r#o4110302##k.
